title: W(E6) Orbit Structure on Lambda_C Discriminant Cosets
verdict: COMPLETE: The 255 discriminant cosets of Lambda_C decompose as {1}+{135}+{120} under W(E6). The anisotropic 120-orbit = 240 E8 roots/pm1 = W(3,3) edges. The isotropic 135-orbit = O+(8,2) polar graph vertices. The E6/E8 confluence is arithmetically complete.
